predicate_atom_catalog_construction.rule: Exhaustively construct every finite exact authority-resolved frozen-I03 predicate leaf lawful for the exact sealed source/release/risk scope: governed coordinate values/states, survey-response values/states, routing/applicability states, exact baseline/risk-cohort predicates, and exact prior-ancestry branch predicates required by accepted families. Never use observed prevalence/support/association/diagnostics for eligibility. Canonicalize by ExactRef and semantic hash; fail closed on missing authority.

query_template_catalog_construction.rule: For every exact compatible source/release/risk/measure/topology partition, construct every frozen-I03 EmpiricalQuerySpec template needed by accepted I05 compiler forms over every canonical exact target tuple of arity 1..J, including scalar marginals/conditioned templates, all arity-general joints, and exact declared target cells. No new I03 truth conditions and no result-dependent admission.

K_bound.closure_rule: K_partition = count(distinct exact eligible conditioner atom refs in one compatible scope/risk partition after duplicate-ref and exact-scope incompatibility removal only); maximum_conditioner_arity_K = max(K_partition).
K_bound.exclusions: Only duplicate refs, cross-source/release/risk incompatibility, or predicates lacking finite exact authority; never observed rarity, weakness, redundancy, cost or unary-null signal.

J_bound.closure_rule: J_partition = count(distinct exact target refs jointly lawful under one source/release/risk/measure/topology partition with complete frozen-I03 domain/topology authority); maximum_target_arity_J = max(J_partition) and must be identical in grammar limits and DiscoveryAuthority.topology_scope.
J_bound.exclusions: Only target tuples not jointly lawful under exact authority.

recursive_depth_bound.closure_rule: A recursive branch may add only previously unused conditioner ExactRefs while retaining exact parent ancestry and fixed source/release/risk scope; maximum_recursive_depth_partition = K_partition; global recorded bound is max across partitions.

source_universe_scope.proposal: One production DiscoveryAuthority instance per exact source universe plus exact sealed release. Multiple instances may coexist in a registry but execute independently. Cross-universe pooling/composition requires separate positive exact SourceUniverseRelation/nonduplication/estimand authority.

empirical_time_release_scope.proposal: Bind exactly one immutable C11LogicalRelease ref plus exact empirical-universe ref, source snapshot/retention identity, source SHA-256 and governed effective-time/release identity. No latest/default/fuzzy/nearest substitution. New release means new authority/frontier.

risk_set_scope.proposal: Admit every exact governed risk-set ref for the sealed universe whose routing/applicability rule or exact membership authority is complete and replayable. Construct risk membership before tested condition; never infer from missingness/outcomes/support. Partition atoms/templates/rules by exact risk compatibility.

measure_scope.proposal: Evaluate all exact measure bases authorized for the sealed source/risk partition: RAW where authorized plus every exact governed weighted/design estimand with complete weight/design/estimand/normalization authority. Distinct templates/results per measure; no default weight or fallback.

topology_scope.proposal: Admit every exact topology class reconstructible by frozen I03 for the sealed release with complete authority; preserve 0/1/many occurrence semantics, components, multiplicity, event identity, order, rank and repetition. Unsupported/incomplete topology fails closed and is listed in the instance exclusion manifest.

already_governed_general_law_carried_unc: multi-universe noncollapse and positive-authority composition only
candidate_rule_closure: After catalogs and K/J/depth are frozen, deterministically instantiate the complete type/scope-compatible expansion of every already-accepted family/form role assignment for every lawful arity up to closure. Observed data and diagnostics cannot affect rule reachability.
freeze_before_data_sequence: resolve exact sealed release/universe and governing authority
compile and seal candidate frontier identity/count
only then examine observed response data
governance_required: HQ must adopt, amend, or reject this proposal before it can bind production discovery or authorize C05-R2 as production execution.
